title: Audience Team Staff Updates
summary: We’re pleased to share some news on a leadership role for Lindsey Wiebe, and welcome two new colleagues – Jill Reilly and Diana Riojas.
body_markdown:
Lindsey Wiebe has a new leadership position, and Jill Reilly and Diana Riojas have joined The Times. Read more from the Audience team.


We’re pleased to share some news on a leadership role for Lindsey Wiebe, and welcome two new colleagues – Jill Reilly and Diana Riojas.


Since joining The Times, Lindsey Wiebe has been at the forefront of some of our most ambitious international audience growth initiatives. She’ll now bring that experience and knowledge of global media to a new leadership position as our embedded audience editor for the International desk.


In this new role on Audience, Lindsey will work closely with desk leadership in New York and worldwide to shape coverage and strategy, while serving as a crucial bridge for our audience editors in London and Seoul.


Since joining The Times, Lindsey has worked closely with the International desk, most recently on the desk’s live coverage. Before that, she supported the development of our international home page and worked with International and Express to expand our coverage of Canada.


“Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen the tangible impact that Lindsey can bring to the international report across a variety of projects, most recently on the opportunity in Canada,” said Bo Kim, director of international audience, strategy and operations. “Her partnership will be critical as we push to bring more stories in more formats that engage readers and watchers around the world.”


Lindsey joined The Times in 2018 as our first Canada audience growth editor. She then worked on international S.E.O. before moving on to work on international growth and strategy. Prior to that she worked for various Canadian newspapers and magazines as a reporter, digital editor and audience strategist.


— Jake Grovum


Jill Reilly has joined the Audience team as a senior audience editor in London.


In her new role, Jill will be a partner to editors across our London newsroom, identifying audience trends and opportunities, providing reporting and analysis on our coverage and monitoring competitor performance. She’ll also help bridge our international hubs, working with Jen Thomas in Seoul to carry audience priorities through the London day and help set up the New York morning.


Jill comes to us from Sky News in London, where as assistant editor, she led the digital news desk coverage, commissioned teams in the U.K. newsroom and worldwide bureaus, and oversaw app curation and breaking news alerts. Her earlier work included producing the broadcaster’s television news hours. Previously Jill was a news editor at MailOnline in New York, where she oversaw coverage of domestic U.S. news.


Jill lives in northeast London with her husband and two daughters.


— Lindsey Wiebe


Credit: Liz Del Carmen


Diana Riojas has joined the Audience team as an audience editor on Metro.


She comes to us from The City Reporter, where she handled its audience operation. Diana brings deep knowledge of New York City along with experience in new story formats and creative approaches to covering the city.


Metro is experimenting with new formats and columns to build its audience, like[Affording New York](https://www.nytimes.com/column/affording-new-york) , the popular column that launched earlier this year. So Diana’s expertise will help the desk find the best opportunities to promote its coverage of the city.


“What struck me about Diana was her enthusiasm and ability to think outside the box when trying to engage new audiences and retain current readers,” said Nikita Stewart, Metro editor.


As audience manager for The City Reporter, Diana expanded the newsroom’s presence off-platform, spearheaded its vertical video strategy, and worked to make New Yorkers loyal readers of the publication.


Diana graduated from the S.I. Newhouse School of Public Communications at Syracuse University.


— Jennie Coughlin


Credit: Liz Del Carmen
